intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.body: Amani Resorts ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting the privacy of our platform's users. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, share and protect your personal information.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data we collect
dataCollected.intro: We collect the following categories of data:

items.label: Identification data:
items.text: first name, last name, email address, phone number

dataUse.title: 3. How we use data
items: Provide and improve our booking services
Calculate your carbon footprint and offer offsets
Communicate with you about your bookings

dataSharing.title: 4. Data sharing
dataSharing.intro: We only share your data with:

items.label: Our partners:
items.text: accommodations, coworking spaces and activities you book

dataSharing.noSale: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

retention.title: 5. Data retention
retention.intro: We keep your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with our legal obligations:
items: Account data: until account deletion + 3 years

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:

items.label: Access:
items.text: obtain a copy of your data

items.label: Portability:
items.text: receive your data in a structured format

items.label: Objection:
items.text: object to the processing of your data

items.label: Restriction:
items.text: restrict the processing of your data

rights.contactNote: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@amaniresorts.com.

security.title: 7. Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data:
items: Secure storage on servers in Europe (EU)

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies to improve your experience.

contact.title: 9. Contact
contact.intro: For any question about this policy or your personal data:
contact.address: Address: Avenue de la Corniche, Moroni, Comoros

changes.title: 10. Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Any change will be posted on this page with a new update date. We will notify you by email of significant changes.
